definitions.gloss: eclipse; obscuration of a celestial body
definitions.explanation: An astronomical eclipse, in which one celestial body is wholly or partly hidden by another. A literary or technical term that most often appears in compounds such as {日蝕|にっしょく} (solar eclipse) and {月蝕|げっしょく} (lunar eclipse); the modern everyday spelling uses {食|しょく}.

examples.japanese: {蝕|しょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
{蝕|しょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦{三時|さんじ}→三時：10983_sanji⟧ごろだ。
examples.english: The peak of the eclipse will be around three in the afternoon.

examples.japanese: {天文|てんもん}⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{蝕|しょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{熱心|ねっしん}→熱心：01207_nesshin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Astronomy enthusiasts were eagerly observing how the eclipse progressed.

notes:
A literary and technical term for an eclipse. In everyday writing the {食|しょく} spelling is standard, so {蝕|しょく} mostly appears in older or specialist astronomical texts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蝕|しょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧: the eclipse begins
- {蝕|しょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧: the maximum (peak) of an eclipse
- {皆既|かいき}{蝕|しょく}: total eclipse

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日食|にっしょく}→日食：06311_nisshoku⟧: solar eclipse — the everyday compound for an eclipse of the sun
- ⟦{月食|げっしょく}→月食：06312_gesshoku⟧: lunar eclipse — the everyday compound for an eclipse of the moon
